description: Remove a blocking dependency between tasks. Provide the same `depends_on` or `dependency_of` used to create it (exactly one is required). Returns a confirmation.

custom_task_ids.description: Set true when the task ids are custom task IDs instead of native ClickUp IDs. Requires `team_id`.

dependency_of.description: ID of the task that depended on THIS task, to remove that link.

depends_on.description: ID of the task THIS task was waiting for, to remove that link.

task_id.description: ID of the task the dependency is anchored on.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

name: delete_task_dependency
